note: Both blobs use the SAME passphrase.
passphraseStorage: D:\ERS_MDM_KEY_BACKUP\PASSPHRASE.txt + your password manager. Never store it next to the blobs.

blobs.purpose: APK signing keystore (com.erstech.mdmlock) - REQUIRED to publish APK updates
blobs.restoreCmd: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File mdm_app\tools\keystore_backup.ps1 -Action Restore -In mdm_app\backup\ers_mdm.jks.ersk -Out mdm_app\keystore\ers_mdm.jks -Passphrase <pass> -Force

blobs.purpose: Licence signing PRIVATE key - REQUIRED to mint offline tokens / sign licences

verified: round-trip restore of both blobs produced byte-identical files (sha256 matched)
